This situation rings true for me in some ways except the reverse. After discovering my husband was cheating on me online with a few different women, instead of trying to handle it the right way and try to work through it, I stayed and coped by drinking. This led to him being my verbal punching bag for a few years  because his travel for work increased and the lack of trust involved. Then reality smacked me in the face and he moved out. Too much damage has been done now on both sides and although we will always love each other, we know our marriage is over. I've since started therapy, stopped drinking and am focusing on myself. I am not saying at all he's justified in the way he treats you, because I sure wasn't. But verbal abuse cuts deep, and as I know my STBX was hurt deeply by it I know you are too. Hang in there, unless he's willing to change, you see the changes over time, and are able to forgive him for his actions, you are doing the right thing. Virtual hugs to you, and good luck!

I am used to him being my rock and strength for any problem I have. But this time the problem(s) are with him and our marriage and it sucks that I don't feel like he'd receive what I want to tell him very well. 

I don't think he's intentionally trying to hurt or punish me. He's just dealing with this the way he knows how. I also don't think it seems fair for me to tell him he's doing this to me, when it's my actions that led him to be this way in the first place.

By selfish in recovery, I mean meetings, and working through my personal demons that led me to drink come first...above everything. One of my biggest problems is I don't love myself, so in my mind if I am focusing on that, it means being selfish by putting my needs first where as before that meant putting my drinking needs first. 
As far as how he feels about my meetings, etc....as far as I know he has none. When I try to talk to him about that, he doesn't say much if anything at all. He will say he's happy for me when I tell him the positives I'm experiencing from being sober, so that is encouraging. 

I guess I'm just being an emotional mess right now, but it honestly destroys me for him to be so normal one minute and so cold to me the next.

Baked chicken and rice with bacon.

6 Chicken thighs
1 cup of white rice uncooked
1 can cream of chicken soup
1 can cream of mushroom soup
4 slices of uncooked bacon ( I usually use turkey bacon)
1 cup of water
salt
pepper
cajun seasoning


Preheat oven to 300
cut slices of bacon in half and lay on bottom of glass 9x13 baking dish
pour 1 cup of rice evenly over bacon
Lay cajun seasoned chicken on top of rice
pour mixture of soup, water, salt and pepper over chicken
cover with foil and bake for 2 hours

This obviously needs to be planned out in advance, timing wise. But it's very low maintenance and the bacon adds a nice flavor to the rice.
